description.value:
Your Techniques burn at the full furnace of your cosmo, not half.

All your Techniques gain one additional heightening step, as though you were 2 levels higher than you are. This applies to every Technique you know, at every slot.

Balance note: this is deliberately a capstone-tier feat — roughly +15% Technique output, and it stacks with Cloth Attunement at 17th for two steps. Watch it in play.
